assumptions: The metapredict version chosen; its network reproduces a consensus of other predictors, not an experiment.
limits: A consensus-trained prediction: it inherits the biases of the predictors it was trained to reproduce.
Domain boundaries come from the smoothed profile and move with the smoothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: What is this protein's per-residue disorder score, and which regions are IDRs, by metapredict?

description: Per-residue intrinsic disorder by metapredict (Emenecker, Griffith & Holehouse, Biophys J 2021; V2/V3 the lab's successors), a bidirectional LSTM trained to reproduce a consensus of disorder predictors, run locally. Reports a 0–1 score per residue, the IDRs and folded domains its domain caller draws from the smoothed profile, and the percentage of residues at or above the network's threshold. A different question from protein_disorder's FoldIndex, which reads composition alone.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

convert.description: read B as N, U as C, X as G and Z as Q, as metapredict's FASTA readers do; off refuses them. Default true. Advanced.

gapClosure.description: the longest run of sub-threshold residues closed when flanked by disordered runs of the same length. Default 10. Advanced.

minimumFoldedDomain.description: gaps between IDRs shorter than this are re-tested at 0.75× the threshold, so short ordered stretches inside an IDR are absorbed. Default 50. Advanced.

minimumIdrSize.description: the shortest IDR the domain caller reports, in residues; also sets the smoothing window (twice this, made odd). Default 12. Advanced.

protein.description: the protein sequence; wire it from translate_sequence.

threshold.description: smoothed score above which a residue can seed an IDR, and per-residue score at or above which it counts as disordered. Omit for the network's own: V1 0.42, V2 and V3 0.5.

version.description: which trained network: V3 (the package default), V2, or V1 (the published 2021 network). Values: V3 (V3 (default)), V2 (V2), V1 (V1 (published, legacy)).

name: protein_disorder_metapredict

converted.description: how many B/U/X/Z residues were read as N/C/G/Q

disorderedResidues.description: how many residues score at or above the threshold

foldedDomains.description: the complementary folded domains, same shape

idrResidues.description: how many residues the IDRs cover

idrs.description: intrinsically disordered regions as 1-based inclusive spans with their length and mean score

percentDisordered.description: percentage of residues scoring at or above the threshold, to 3 dp

scores.description: the per-residue disorder score, 0–1, residue 1 first
